# ethereum-optimism/infra Daily Update (Mar 13, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw significant progress in addressing derivation pipeline error handling and span batch extraction issues, with two key issues being closed. Discussions continued on a memory leak issue related to `op-reth` database transactions.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

No new features, bug fixes, code refactoring, documentation enhancements, or tests were added.

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
No new pull requests were opened.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Derivation Pipeline Error Handling
An audit of the derivation pipeline's external-input error handling was completed and closed [#19491](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19491). This audit focused on ensuring that malformed or bad external L1 inputs do not halt derivation but are instead dropped, allowing processing to continue.

### Span Batch Extraction Failure Resolution
An issue concerning span batch extraction failure in `BatchQueue` returning `Critical` instead of flushing was closed [#19511](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19511). The decision was made to preserve historical behavior where dropped batches do not flush the channel, as the behavior for invalid batch data was previously unspecified and not encountered in production.

### Rust Docs Hosting Strategy
The issue regarding Rust Docs Hosting was closed [#1985](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/1985), as it has been captured within the broader documentation migration project.

## NEW ISSUES
No new issues were reported.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### op-reth Database Read Transaction Memory Leak
Discussion continued on the `op-reth` database read transaction causing memory leaks [#19212](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19212). A new comment from 0xForerunner indicated that World Chain v1.10.1 is also experiencing this issue, leading to nodes crashing. They inquired if upgrading to v1.11 resolved the problem for jonathanudd, who previously noted that they had not yet upgraded to v1.11.0 but had not seen the behavior in the last 7 days on v1.10.2.
